versions.changelog:
No functional or content changes in this version.

- No file changes detected; SKILL.md content remains the same.
- Version bumped for maintenance or metadata update.

- Initial release: index of ready-to-run iOS animation code examples, organized by category (Menu, Transition, Indicator, Alert, Animation, Tableview, Collectionview, UI), sourced from MotionBook.
- Skill provides quick references and links to working Swift animation demos, with categories for common UI motion tasks.
- Each category lists top projects and points to a reference file for more options.
- Designed for use when implementing iOS UIKit/SwiftUI animations—fetch a runnable example before creating new motion code.
- Excludes SwiftUI `.animation`, Lottie/Rive, and Core Animation tutorials; see related skills for those.
